# OMELink

**OMELink** is an R package designed for individual-level record
linkage, implementing a hybrid matching framework that combines exact,
partial, and fuzzy matching approaches to identify the most probable
record pairs.

## Installation

You can install the development version of OMElink from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Jake-Powell/OMELink")
```

For examples of how to use the package see the [Matching Names to a Name
Database
vignette](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/articles/Matching_names_to_a_name_database.html).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`check_ID()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/check_ID.md)
  : Check ID Column Format and Establishment Number Consistency
- [`classify_match_decision()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/classify_match_decision.md)
  : Classify Match Decision and Review Requirement
- [`clean_name()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/clean_name.md)
  : Clean names
- [`clean_school_name()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/clean_school_name.md)
  : Clean and Standardise School Names for Matching
- [`collapse_to_best_per_upi()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/collapse_to_best_per_upi.md)
  : Collapse Multiple Candidate Rows to Best Row per Identifier
- [`derive_match_method()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/derive_match_method.md)
  : Derive Human-Readable Match Method Labels
- [`escape_regex()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/escape_regex.md)
  : Escape regular expression special characters
- [`expand_name_variants()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/expand_name_variants.md)
  : Expand Rows by Name Variants
- [`format_top_matches()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/format_top_matches.md)
  : Format Top Candidate Matches for Manual Review
- [`get_weights_basic()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/get_weights_basic.md)
  : Basic Token Weighting Function for School Name Matching
- [`link_establishment()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/link_establishment.md)
  : Link School Names to an Establishment List
- [`match_people_to_data()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/match_people_to_data.md)
  : Match Multiple People to Grouped Data
- [`match_people_to_data2()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/match_people_to_data2.md)
  : Match Multiple People to a Reference Data Set
- [`match_person_to_data()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/match_person_to_data.md)
  : Match a Person's Name to a Data Frame of Individuals
- [`match_person_to_data2()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/match_person_to_data2.md)
  : Match a Person to a Candidate Data Set Using Exact, Partial, and
  Fuzzy Matching
- [`match_person_to_grouped_data()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/match_person_to_grouped_data.md)
  : Match a Person to Grouped Data
- [`match_person_to_grouped_data2()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/match_person_to_grouped_data2.md)
  : Match a Person to Grouped Data Using Exact, Partial, and Fuzzy
  Matching
- [`matching_breakdown()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/matching_breakdown.md)
  : Build First-Name and Last-Name Matching Breakdown
- [`name_similarity_jw()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/name_similarity_jw.md)
  : Compute Token-Based Jaro-Winkler Name Similarity
- [`partial_fuzzy_match()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/partial_fuzzy_match.md)
  : Compute Partial and Fuzzy Matching Signals for a Single Name
- [`rank_name_matches()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/rank_name_matches.md)
  : Rank Candidate Name Matches
- [`score_name_matches()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/score_name_matches.md)
  : Score Combined First-Name and Last-Name Matches
- [`standardise_match_people()`](https://jake-powell.github.io/OMELink/reference/standardise_match_people.md)
  : Standardise matched people output
